title: prism store 增 fundamental_q 表
description: internal/storage/prism/sqlite.go schema 追加 fundamental_q 表(PK: instrument_id+period_end, WITHOUT ROWID),新增 FundamentalRow 类型与 UpsertFundamentals/QuarterlyFundamentals 方法(与 UpsertValuations 同款:事务+Prepare+toNull/fromNull)。详见计划 Task 2。

functional: TestUpsertFundamentalsRoundtrip 通过:UpsertFundamentals 写入后 QuarterlyFundamentals 按 period_end 升序读回,字段逐一相等
FundamentalRow 字段与计划接口契约一致:FiscalPeriod/PeriodEnd/FilingDate/Revenue/NetIncome/EPSDiluted/Equity/DilutedShares/Source
boundary: NaN 字段落库为 NULL,读回为 NaN(Equity NaN 用例)
同批 rows 重复 Upsert 两次幂等:行数不变,ON CONFLICT 全列覆盖
error_handling: 空 rows 切片 Upsert 不报错且不产生行

non_functional.desc: go test ./internal/storage/prism/ 全 PASS(既有 valuation/instrument 用例回归)
